sn55.20:1.1: Atha kho Bhagavā seyyathāpi nāma balavā puriso || pe || evam eva Jetavane antarahito devesu Tāvatiṃsesu pātur ahosi || || 3.
sn55.20:1.2: Atha kho sambahulā Tāvatiṃsakāyikā devatāyo yena Bhagavā tenupasaṅkamiṃsu || upasaṅkamitvā Bhagavantaṃ abhivādetvā ekam antam aṭṭhaṃsu || || Ekam antaṃ ṭhitā kho tā devatāyo Bhagavā etad avoca || || 4--7.
sn55.20:2.1: Sādhu kho āvuso Buddhe aveccappasādena samannāgamanaṃ hoti ||
sn55.20:2.2: Iti pi so Bhagavā || la-pe || satthā devamanussānam buddho bhagavā ti || ||
sn55.20:2.3: Buddhe aveccappasādena samannāgamanahetu kho āvuso evam idhekacce sattā sotāpannā avinipātadhammā niyatā sambodhiparāyanā || ||
sn55.20:2.6: Ariyakantehi sīlehi samannāgamanam hoti akhaṇḍehi || lape || samādhisaṃvattanikehi || ||
sn55.20:2.7: Ariyakantehi sīlehi samannāgamana hetu kho āvuso evam idhekacce sattā sotāpannā avinipātadhammā niyatā sambodhiparāyanā ti || || 8--11.
sn55.20:3.1: Sādhu kho mārisa Buddhe aveccappasādena samannāgamanaṃ hoti ||
sn55.20:3.2: Iti pi so Bhagavā || la-pe || satthā devamanussānam buddho bhagavā ti || ||
sn55.20:3.3: Buddhe aveccappasādena samannāgamanahetu kho mārisa evam ayam pajā sotāpannā avinipātadhammā niyatā sambodhiparāyanā || ||
sn55.20:3.6: ariyakantehi sīlehi samannāgamanaṃ hoti akhaṇḍehi || la-pe || samādhisaṃvattanikehi || ||
